verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Adaptive Telemetry suite is described as automatically identifying valuable data and aggregating the rest to cut telemetry costs by up to 80%. That is a glancing, marketing-level nod to deliberate data-volume management. Nothing in the pack documents developer-controlled trace or log sampling rules, or configurable retention tiers. missing for 10: explicit trace sampling configuration (head/tail), log sampling/drop controls, configurable retention periods or tiers per signal, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
